name: CSS Box Shadow Generator
summary: Design multi-layer box-shadows with a live preview and copy-ready CSS — locally.
description: Tune offset, blur, spread, color, and inset per layer. Stack multiple shadows, preview live, and copy a box-shadow declaration or rule. Everything runs in your browser.

faqs.question: Can I stack multiple shadows?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add layers and enable/disable them individually. Enabled layers are joined with commas.

faqs.question: What does inset do?
faqs.answer: Inset draws the shadow inside the element instead of outside.

faqs.question: Is my CSS uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
